title: Grateful Dead Live at Irvine Meadows Amphitheater on 1985-04-13
lineage: MAC>Nakamichi Cassette Deck 2(azimuth adjusted)>RCA>Edirol UA-5>USB>WinXP Pro> CEP 2.0>CD Wave Editor>Flac Frontend(encoded at level 8)>FLAC16
source: MAC: (FOB) Sennheiser 421's* > Sony D5 > Maxell XLII-S 90(Set I) & Maxell MX 90(Set II)

ai_review.summary: A beloved second‑set and standout Terrapin Station, but the soundboard mix buries Brent’s keyboards; a front‑row Sennheiser 441 audience capture offers clearer audio.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the show’s warm, psychedelic second set and cite Terrapin Station as a highlight, saying it feels like home. The official soundboard recording is criticized for a botched mix that drowns out Brent’s keys and low‑bit depth, while an audience tape recorded with Sennheiser 441s provides a cleaner listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Show performance is praised highly (≈4.5/5) while recording quality is mixed (≈3.2/5); weighted average yields about 4.1 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Board mix heavily buries Brent’s keyboards, especially on the Terrapin outro; listeners complain of low‑bit depth (SBD) and request FLAC16. An audience tape using front‑row Sennheiser 441 microphones is noted as clean with no cuts.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set described as a comforting psychedelic blanket that unfolds gently; overall vibe feels like home for long‑time listeners.

band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s keyboards are buried or missing in the board mix, though the audience tape captures them clearly.
